additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437209-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / R9 170002647] Charging status “waiting” state CRM:02684000403
additional_info.body:
Dear Giuseppe Buffardi,
Hope you are doing well.
As we analyzed the logs, there is no error currently on this charger, and it is showing healthy on SCB. Based on the timestamp provided along with this ticket, we further checked the logs and observed the charging session was stopped from the EV side. Here we can see in the logs the source is EV, {"source":"EV","user":"internal"}.
This behavior often indicates a badly connected plug to the vehicle. In such cases, removing the plug and re-attempting the charging session has resolved the issue successfully.
We did not observe any further issue with the charging session.
If this answer to your query, shall we move ahead and close this ticket.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
